description:
ENS resolve on Ethereum mainnet: pass name (an ASCII .eth name) for its forward-resolved address, or address (0x + 40 hex) for its verified reverse name. One paid call, USDC on Base.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_ens_resolve. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_ens_resolve
